title: AI demand drives record APAC pipeline
lede: Asia-Pacific's data center development pipeline hit a record 26.5 GW in the first half of 2026, with AI pre-leasing tightening supply across the region's major markets. Southeast Asia remained the focal point of new capacity: YTL Power and JLand announced a campus of up to 1.5 GW in Johor, among the largest projects ever planned in the region, while Singapore awarded its second tranche of capacity under the DC-CFA2 process to Digital Realty, Equinix, Keppel and STT GDC at 50 MW each. Vietnam's pipeline advanced through new land leases in Ho Chi Minh City even as STT GDC exited its joint venture there to VNG. In North Asia, South Korea paired a state-backed investment program with private deals including NVIDIA's $1 billion commitment to NAVER, though power design and cooling constraints surfaced around its 8.4 GW buildout ambition. China's development continued shifting inland toward Inner Mongolia and Guizhou on energy and climate advantages, and Japan saw landmark leasing in Greater Tokyo alongside proposals to site what could become the country's largest AI facility in Akita.

themes.heading: Record APAC pipeline as AI tightens supply
themes.narrative: Asia-Pacific's data center development pipeline reached a record 26.5 GW in the first half of 2026, driven by investment in AI and cloud infrastructure. Strong pre-leasing from AI tenants is tightening available supply across the region. Power availability is increasingly the decisive factor in site selection and project timelines.
themes.heading_zh: AI加剧供应紧张，亚太地区在建规模创历史新高
themes.narrative_zh: 2026年上半年，亚太地区数据中心开发管线达到创纪录的26.5 GW，受AI和云基础设施投资推动。来自AI租户的强劲预租正在收紧整个地区的可用供应。电力供应正日益成为选址和项目时间表的决定性因素。

themes.heading: Johor mega-campus and Singapore capacity awards
themes.narrative: YTL Power and JLand Group formed a partnership to develop a data center campus in Johor with planned capacity of up to 1.5 GW, which would rank among Southeast Asia's largest developments. Singapore awarded capacity under its second Data Centre Call for Application to Digital Realty, Equinix, Keppel and STT GDC, each receiving 50 MW. Tencent Cloud also plans a new Malaysia cloud region with three availability zones.
themes.heading_zh: 柔佛超大规模园区落地，新加坡公布容量分配结果
themes.narrative_zh: YTL Power与JLand Group达成合作，将在柔佛开发一个规划容量高达1.5 GW的数据中心园区，该项目将跻身东南亚最大的开发项目之列。新加坡在第二轮数据中心申请征集（Data Centre Call for Application）中向Digital Realty、Equinix、Keppel和STT GDC授予容量，每家获得50 MW。腾讯云还计划在马来西亚设立一个新的云区域，包含三个可用区。

themes.heading: Vietnam pipeline advances amid ownership shift
themes.narrative: Ho Chi Minh City authorities leased a 5-hectare parcel for a Singapore-backed $508 million data center project, while Evolution DC secured a long-term land lease for a planned 52 MW facility in the Saigon Hi-Tech Park. At the same time, STT GDC is exiting its planned joint venture in the city, with Vietnamese tech company VNG taking over its stake and pursuing further development.
themes.heading_zh: 所有权结构变动之际，越南在建项目持续推进
themes.narrative_zh: 胡志明市当局为一个由新加坡支持、投资额5.08亿美元的数据中心项目出租了一块5公顷的地块，同时Evolution DC获得了一份长期土地租约，用于在西贡高科技园区建设一个规划容量52 MW的设施。与此同时，STT GDC正在退出其在该市计划中的合资企业，越南科技公司VNG将接手其股份并推进进一步开发。

themes.heading: Korea scales AI capacity, bottlenecks emerge
themes.narrative: South Korea launched a data center investment program cited at 1,200 trillion won to localize AI infrastructure, and NVIDIA committed $1 billion to NAVER to expand domestic AI capacity. Alibaba Cloud opened its third Korean data center, and telcos collectively passed KRW 1 trillion in first-half AI data center revenue. However, the country's roughly 8.4 GW buildout plan is running into power design and cooling constraints, and operators face a growing war for skilled blue-collar talent.
themes.heading_zh: 韩国扩大AI容量，瓶颈逐渐显现
themes.narrative_zh: 韩国启动了一项据称达1,200万亿韩元的数据中心投资计划，以实现AI基础设施本地化，NVIDIA承诺向NAVER投资10亿美元以扩大国内AI产能。阿里云开设了其在韩国的第三个数据中心，电信运营商上半年AI数据中心收入合计突破1万亿韩元。然而，该国约8.4 GW的建设计划正遭遇电力设计和冷却方面的制约，运营商还面临日益激烈的技术蓝领人才争夺战。

themes.heading: China's build-out shifts inland
themes.narrative: Surging AI computing demand is pushing Chinese tech giants toward Inner Mongolia, drawn by energy resources and a cooler climate, redistributing capacity away from coastal hubs. Guizhou, despite being one of China's most indebted provinces, now hosts some of the country's largest data centers. Construction is proceeding with little local opposition even as AI-driven energy demand rises, while questions persist over whether China can deliver competitive AI performance without NVIDIA GPUs.
themes.heading_zh: 中国数据中心建设向内陆转移
themes.narrative_zh: 激增的AI算力需求正推动中国科技巨头转向内蒙古，那里丰富的能源资源和更凉爽的气候颇具吸引力，产能正从沿海枢纽重新分配。贵州尽管是中国负债最重的省份之一，如今却拥有该国一些最大的数据中心。即使AI驱动的能源需求不断上升，建设工作仍在推进，几乎没有遇到当地反对；与此同时，关于中国能否在没有NVIDIA GPU的情况下提供有竞争力的AI性能，疑问依然存在。

themes.heading: Japan expands beyond the Tokyo corridor
themes.narrative: Goodman Group signed a 20-year lease with an unnamed global hyperscaler for the first 50 MW phase of Tsukuba Tech Central, its planned 1 GW Greater Tokyo campus, with power secured from TEPCO. Meanwhile, the northern city of Akita is considering hosting what could become Japan's largest AI data center, a project that drew a visit from the UAE ambassador for investment talks. The moves signal both deep hyperscaler commitment and geographic diversification in Japan's market.
themes.heading_zh: 日本扩张步伐超出东京走廊
themes.narrative_zh: Goodman Group与一家未具名的全球hyperscaler签署了为期20年的租约，承租Tsukuba Tech Central首期50 MW——这是其规划的1 GW大东京园区项目，电力已从TEPCO获得保障。与此同时，北部城市秋田正在考虑承接可能成为日本最大AI数据中心的项目，该项目还吸引了阿联酋大使到访洽谈投资。这些举措既表明hyperscaler的深度投入，也显示出日本市场的地理多元化趋势。
